description.content:
Search upcoming streams by date, artist, genre, and more.
Past streams are not available via the API.

query.description: Page number of results to retrieve
Number of events per page of results

Use a dynamic date preset.
- eventDatePreset=tomorrow

Notes: 
- The `eventDatePreset` will override `eventDateFrom` & `eventDateTo` if those are set as well.
- The `halloween` preset returns events on 10/31 only. The `newYears` preset returns events on 12/31 only. The `july4th` preset returns events on or near July 4th.

For `concerts` must start on or after this date.\ For `festivals`, must start on or after this date.\ If left blank or omitted, will use the current date.\ The `expandPastEvents` parameter is required when using `eventDateFrom` before the current date. - eventDateFrom=2023-10-31 Note: Dates use RFC3339 format.

For `concerts` must start on or before this date.\ For `festivals` must end on or before this date.\ If left blank or omitted, will return all events after `eventDateFrom`. - eventDateTo=2023-12-31 Note: Dates use RFC3339 format.

Filter streams to those sourced from a specific stream platform.

v3 currently exposes a single source slug — `jambase` — which represents JamBase's normalized stream catalog. Pipe-delimited values are supported for forward compatibility:

- streamDataSource=jambase
Must have been updated on or after this dateTime in GMT.\ If left blank or omitted, will use all updated on dates - dateModifiedFrom=2022-10-31 00:00:00 Note: Use RFC3339 format for parameter values.

Must have been first published on or after this dateTime in GMT.\ \ If left blank or omitted, will use all first published on dates. - datePublishedFrom=2022-01-01 00:00:00 Note: Use RFC3339 format for parameter values.

Use `true` to include external IDs for `Concert`, `Artist`, and `Venue` objects.
\
Note: The `expandExternalIdentifiers` parameter requires that your apikey has the `expandExternalIdentifiers` enhancement turned on. Please contact JamBase to request access to this feature.
Use `true` to include `sameAs` (i.e. links) for `Artist` responses.
